theory_variant: Lean 4.34.1 core dependent type theory; conditional acceptance/diagonal/bridge logic only; no Mathlib, ZFC syntax, or HoTT-specific rule
source_boundary: Foundation provides a generic Gödel technical baseline and set.mm provides a real proof-acceptance interface. This package proves only the explicit conditional logical consequence in its own Lean-core source.
non_goals: a theorem about bare ZFC syntax, models, consistency, or inconsistency
an actual Gödelization of set.mm or bare ZFC
a proof that proof acceptance is a Zeno, circle, or HoTT H0 completion
a reality, time, or process-completion verdict without a separately paid bridge
a theorem that all self-reference produces contradiction
